text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Brrr~~. What a heavy blizzard...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I'm glad there was a shop 
nearby... The book I bought at the used 
bookstore almost got soaked.)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, we're currently very crowded... 
Would you mind sharing a table...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes, I'm fine...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Cafe-san...? So you were the one 
sharing the table with me!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: U-Um... I'm sorry if I'm interrupting...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ……That book…… It's very…… old…… isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? T-This book? How did you know I had 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My "friend" is talking... with the child 
in the pages. She says... they are happy 
to be read after such a long time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? I see... So... that's a book about 
coffee...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes. It's a book about the history of 
'Sultana Coffee'..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, a hero from abroad used to 
drink it as medicine long ago...! Hehe, 
I'm curious to see what it's like!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Coincidentally, what I am drinking 
right now is sultana coffee. Would you 
like... to try a sip?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really!? Then I'll order the same 
thing—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It has quite a unique flavor... so it 
might be better... to try it first... to 
see if you can handle it...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: *blow, blow* So this is sultana coffee...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: How does it... taste...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It's got a strong taste, but I don't 
dislike it. It might be tasty once I get 
used to it... I'll have this one too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I wonder if heroes of ancient 
times drank this on cold days like today 
as well?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we try... asking the girl... 
inside the book...?
